product_one_liner.value: Lyric Studio is an AI-native platform that helps enterprise supply-chain teams plan, model, optimize and operationalize supply-chain decisions through composable algorithms, workflows and applications.

pricing_page.notes: No public pricing page or pricing navigation was found; the /pricing URL returned no readable page.

eng_blog.notes: Technical posts include “The Technology Behind Modeling at Scale” by Ganesh Ramakrishna and “The Real Reason Your Planning System Slows Down” by Aditya Jaroli and Pradeep Vijayakumar; they explain distributed compute, sequence orchestration, storage/cache architecture and scenario cloning.

public_docs.notes: The documentation subdomain exposes only a documentation-access landing page, not several publicly readable product articles; no public help center was found.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: Live Applied AI / GTM Engineer role in Bengaluru builds AI-powered products and agents; this is an engineering role, not an AI-sales position.

model_provider.notes: Reviewed platform and technical posts, documentation-access page, security/trust portal, privacy policy and available subprocessor information; no production AI model provider was established. NVIDIA cuOpt and Gurobi are named optimization integrations, not evidence of an LLM provider.

compliance_certs.notes: The portal explicitly claims ISO 27001 certification and SOC 2 attestation and lists GDPR under Compliance; GDPR is a compliance claim rather than a certification.

last_funding.notes: Current company pages state a $55.5M Series B. The original announcement was dated 2025-08-05 and reported $43.5M; a subsequent extension date is not publicly established, so the date is omitted rather than assigning the original date to the enlarged amount.

raised_18mo.notes: The $43.5M Series B announcement on 2025-08-05 falls within 2025-05-09 through 2026-11-09.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live board lists Enterprise Account Executive roles for the US, Benelux, DACH, Spain and UK.

launched_6mo.notes: “Agents Meet Demand Forecasting,” dated 2026-08-04, announces an agentic demand-forecasting launch within the requested window.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: CEO Ganesh Ramakrishna announced on 2026-04-29 that Sean Zonneveld was joining as EVP Sales.

crm_stack_signal.notes: The Applied AI / GTM Engineer posting explicitly names these tools in Lyric’s GTM stack.
